printed_facts.fact: Scale from 0 to 70, with increments of 5.

public_definitions: Review the renewable generation dashboard, identify the largest renewable generation contribution source, then route that source record to priority contribution follow-up.
Use the dashboard to determine which renewable generation source is the largest contribution source for this routing decision.
Largest renewable generation contribution source is defined by the highest percentage value shown in the chart.
